links.outcome: Sonographer workflow efficiency, fatigue and image quality with versus without AI assistance in a randomized crossover trial
links.effect: AI days vs non-AI days: exam time 13.0±3.5 vs 14.3±4.2 min (P<0.001); daily exams 16.7±2.5 vs 14.1±2.5 (P=0.003); mental fatigue 4.1±1.1 vs 4.7±0.6 (P=0.039).
links.quote: This real-world randomized trial demonstrated that AI-based echocardiographic analysis enhances workflow efficiency, reduces sonographer fatigue, and improves image quality without compromising diagnostic integrity.

links.outcome: AI performance as used by sonographers in the intended workflow, including effects on user performance
links.effect: AI assistance shortened exam time, increased daily exams and parameters analyzed (85±12 vs 25±1); AI values agreed with expert-endorsed values within limits for 90% of parameters.
links.quote: This real-world randomized trial demonstrated that AI-based echocardiographic analysis enhances workflow efficiency, reduces sonographer fatigue, and improves image quality without compromising diagnostic integrity.

screen.reason: Randomized crossover trial testing the impact of integrating an AI-assisted automated measurement tool into active sonographer workflows versus manual workflow on examination time, fatigue, and throughput.

primary.practice: AI-assisted automated workflow with clinician verification
